purpose: Primary terrain model (1 m post spacing) for local obstacle avoidance, slope, roughness, and path planning.
selected_because: Official stereo-derived HiRISE DTM covering lower Mount Sharp layered mound and boxwork-bearing formations in Gale Crater. Resolves metric obstacles required by the EVA planning challenge.

purpose: Primary high-resolution optical basemap co-registered to the primary DTM for surface visual inspection.
selected_because: Official orthorectified image corresponding to DTM stereo observation pair PSP_001488_1750 / PSP_001752_1750. Reduced C-version provides full optical coverage at manageable size.

purpose: Fallback and wide-area 1m digital elevation model covering the complete Gale Crater exploration corridor (HRSC + CTX + HiRISE tied to MOLA).
selected_because: USGS Astrogeology peer-reviewed multi-sensor mosaic (Calef & Parker 2016). Ensures spatial continuity and prevents edge artifacts beyond the single HiRISE strip.

purpose: Regional topographic context (128 pixels/degree, ~463 m/pixel) and planetary geodetic datum reference.
selected_because: Official PDS Geosciences Node MGS MOLA Precision Experiment Data Record covering latitude 0 to 44 S, longitude 90 to 180 E.

purpose: Geologic units, structural features, and surface material context for landing site and traverse evaluation.
selected_because: USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3292 (Tanaka et al. 2014, 1:20M). Standard authoritative GIS database for Martian geology.

purpose: Thermal infrared context and thermophysical surface variation layer (100 m/pixel).
selected_because: USGS/ASU 2001 Mars Odyssey THEMIS Daytime Infrared Global Mosaic v12. Notice: due to 22.8 GB size, sub-window / COG range extraction is recommended in WP-06.

purpose: In-situ surface radiation environment measurements (dose rate, galactic cosmic rays, solar particle events) in Gale Crater.
selected_because: NASA PDS Planetary Plasma Interactions (PPI) Node official collection for Curiosity RAD Reduced Data Records.
